title: Harden and speed up a Node.js Dockerfile
ticketBrief:
# Ticket OPS-301
The `api` image builds slowly on every code change, is not reproducible, and runs as root.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Pin the base image to a specific version (not `latest`).
- Copy `package*.json` and install dependencies **before** copying the rest of the source, using `npm ci`, so the dependency layer is cached.
- Run the container as the unprivileged `node` user.

steps.title: Fix the Dockerfile
steps.instruction: Edit Dockerfile so it meets the acceptance criteria.

checks.label: Base image is pinned to a version
Dependencies are installed before the source is copied
Container runs as the node user

hints.body: Layer caching works top to bottom: put the files that change least first.

files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

FROM node:latest
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

title: Make a Kubernetes Deployment production-ready
ticketBrief:
# Ticket OPS-302
The `api` Deployment has one replica, no health checks and no resource settings, so a single crash causes downtime and a noisy pod can starve its neighbours.

**Acceptance criteria**
- At least 2 replicas.
- A readiness probe and a liveness probe.
- CPU and memory **requests** and **limits**.

steps.title: Edit the manifest
steps.instruction: Edit deployment.yaml so it meets the acceptance criteria.

files.deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: example/api:1.4.2
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 3000
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 3000
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: example/api:1.4.2
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 1

    spec:

        - name: api
          image: example/api:1.4.2
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000

title: Fix a CI workflow that never runs the tests
ticketBrief:
# Ticket OPS-303
The CI workflow only runs when someone clicks a button, never checks out the code, and does not actually run the test suite.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Run on every pull request and on pushes to `main`.
- Check out the repository with `actions/checkout@v4`.
- Run `npm test`.

steps.title: Edit the workflow
steps.instruction: Edit ci.yml so it meets the acceptance criteria.

checks.label: Runs on pull requests and pushes to main

files.ci.yml:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - run: npm ci
